Magnitude 6.0 quake hits off southern Philippines: USGS

A magnitude-6.0 earthquake jolted just off the coast of southern Philippines late Saturday, the United States Geological Survey said.

The USGS reported the tremor to occur at a depth of 59 kilometres (37 miles), and about 10 kilometres from Cagwait town in the province of Surigao del Sur.

There were no immediate reports of casualties from the quake, Cagwait Fire Officer Arnel Besinga told AFP. │via Agence France Presse

👉 For more info, visit 🔗 https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI

BREAKING NEWS Philippines :  (  Again ) The magnitude 6.2 earthquake near Cagwait, Surigao del Sur, on October 11 at 10:32 p.m. highlights the seismic activity in the region, which is part of the Pacific Ring of Fire, known for its frequent and sometimes destructive earthquakes. The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) monitors such events closely, providing updates and safety advisories to help communities respond effectively. It is crucial for residents in the area to stay alert for potential aftershocks, follow safety protocols, and prepare emergency kits and plans to mitigate damage and ensure safety.

Source : Inquirer
